Compiled by the Lecturer at the Court and Academician of the Hanlin Academy of Silla in Haedong.

The second section states:
At the age of seventeen, in the fourth year of the Xianqing era (Jiwei), his resolve was sharp and he sought out a teacher.
He traveled extensively throughout the capital and its surrounding regions to visit the eminent monks of the clergy,

Thereupon, he took leave of his kin and sought the Dharma at Mount Taibai.
He cultivated *eiju* (atractylodes) for several years and expounded the Vaipulya sutras.
Later, hearing that his parents were ill, he left the valley and entered the capital.
At that time, Dharma Master Zhiyan was lecturing on the Avataṃsaka Sūtra at Yunhua Temple.
During the middle of the night, Fazang suddenly beheld a divine light coming to illuminate the courtyard and halls.
He then sighed and said:

Yan sighed with admiration, saying:
